name: Top level of manhole to inspection chamber
handbook: Code of Practice on Sewerage and Sanitary Works
sourceFile: Capability Testing Pack/Annex A - The rules/SSW 1.2.1 (b) Top level of manhole to inspection chamber.docx
description: Top levels of Sanitary Drainage System shall be higher than the top level of the manholes to which the development connects.

interpretation.targetElement: DistributionChamberElement (Inspection Chamber) paired with the Manhole it connects to
interpretation.verdictLogic: COMPLIANT if inspectionChamberTopLevel_m >= manholeTopLevel_m (equal is explicitly allowed per Scenario 01-Compliant-2 and Figure 02). NON_COMPLIANT if inspectionChamberTopLevel_m < manholeTopLevel_m.

sampleScenarios.description: Top level of IC is higher than top level of connecting MH.
Top level of IC is the same as top level of connecting MH.
Top level of IC is lower than top level of connecting MH.

matchedPlanElement.note: See docs/rules/ssw-1.2.1-b-ic-mh-level.md for the full reasoning and the exact callouts these values were read from: EXG'T LAST IC new T.L. 110.460 vs EXG'T LAST MH new T.L. 110.450.
